backend/main.mo: Defines user profiles, nutrition entries, health metrics, access control, and query/update methods for profile and record management.
feature_evidence.json: Lists implemented features with associated files, components, test references, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Provides short summaries of various frontend components, pages, hooks, and UI elements.
frontend/android-wrapper/.gitignore: Specifies ignored files and directories for the Android wrapper project.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/build.gradl: Configures Android build settings, dependencies, signing options, and injected web app base URL.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/proguard-ru: Defines ProGuard rules to keep WebView-related classes and wrapper app classes intact.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/An: Declares permissions, app configuration, activity setup, and security settings for the Android wrapper.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/ja: Implements the WebView-based Android activity with Internet Identity handling, camera permissions, and popup management.
frontend/android-wrapper/app/src/main/re: Layout file containing a full-screen WebView container.
Defines app name and the configurable base URL string used by the Android wrapper.
Defines the app theme and color resources for the Android wrapper.
Specifies backup exclusions for WebView-related shared prefs and databases.
Sets cloud-backup exclusions for WebView data.
Configures HTTPS-only traffic and allows specific Internet Computer domains.
frontend/android-wrapper/build.gradle: Configures Android Gradle buildscript, Kotlin plugin, repositories, and a clean task.
frontend/android-wrapper/gradle.properti: Contains Gradle performance settings, AndroidX config, Kotlin style, and the required nutriscan.baseUrl property.
frontend/android-wrapper/gradle/wrapper/: Defines Gradle wrapper distribution settings and version 8.2.
frontend/android-wrapper/README.md: Explains the Android WebView wrapper purpose, setup requirements, and sideload build steps.
frontend/android-wrapper/scripts/package: Builds the release APK, validates config, and copies it to the downloads directory.
frontend/android-wrapper/settings.gradle: Configures plugin management, dependency resolution, and includes the app module.
frontend/index.css: Sets global Tailwind styles and CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point loading the React frontend via main.tsx.
frontend/public/downloads/.gitkeep: Placeholder file to keep the downloads directory in version control.
frontend/public/downloads/README.md: Explains the purpose of the downloads directory and how the APK is generated and served.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines routing, authentication gating, and profile setup checks for the React app.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity with query reset handling.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog for collecting and validating user profile and goal data before saving.
frontend/src/components/camera/CapturedP: Displays a captured photo with options to retake or continue.
frontend/src/components/chat/ChatTranscr: Renders chat messages with auto-scrolling, styling by role, citations, and timestamps.
frontend/src/components/chat/SuggestedPr: Displays a list of suggested questions as buttons that trigger a selection callback.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Baseli: Fetches and displays baseline health metrics with icons, units, and loading/error states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Mainte: Shows TDEE vs today's calories, status indicators, and prompts for missing profile data.
frontend/src/components/entries/DateRang: Provides buttons to shift a numeric date range window and displays the formatted range.
frontend/src/components/entries/EmptyEnt: Displays an illustration and message when no meal entries exist.
frontend/src/components/entries/EntryDet: Dialog showing detailed nutrition info for a food entry with portion-adjusted values.
frontend/src/components/entries/Estimati: Guides confirming an AI-estimated food entry with speech notes, portion/weight edits, and save handling.
frontend/src/components/entries/PortionC: Sliders to adjust portion size and confidence with optional guidance text.
frontend/src/components/entries/SimilarF: Displays a list of similar foods as selectable cards, highlighting the chosen one and passing selection to a callback.
frontend/src/components/entries/TodayEnt: Renders today’s food entries with calories and confidence badges, opening a details dialog when an entry is selected.
frontend/src/components/graphs/CaloriesO: Builds a line chart of daily calorie totals over a date range and allows selecting a day from the chart.
frontend/src/components/graphs/MacroDist: Computes total macros from entries and displays their proportions in a pie chart.
frontend/src/components/graphs/Nutrition: Calculates a nutrition balance score from macro ratios and confidence levels, showing grade, score, and explanation.
frontend/src/components/graphs/WeeklyRat: Shows a 1–10 visual rating scale using colored numbered circles and a star indicator.
frontend/src/components/graphs/WeeklySum: Displays a weekly nutrition summary with rating, feedback, stats, macro totals, and suggestions.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppHeader: Renders the top navigation bar with app branding, navigation buttons, and user login/profile display.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Wraps the app with theming, header, footer, and page layout, setting the document title on load.
frontend/src/config/appBranding.ts: Defines centralized app branding values such as display name, tagline, and description.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the current Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useBaselineHealthSnap: Fetches baseline health snapshots from the backend once an actor is available.
frontend/src/hooks/useCallerHealthMetric: Retrieves caller-specific health metrics, returning null on backend trap.
Fetches suggested questions and provides a helper to find matching or fallback answers.
frontend/src/hooks/useCurrentUserProfile: Loads the caller's user profile and provides a mutation to save profile changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFoodEntries.ts: Fetches food entries for a date range and provides a mutation to add new entries.
frontend/src/hooks/useHealthRecords.ts: Fetches full lab vitals history and allows adding new health snapshots with cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity login state, loading, and client creation for authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/usePortionAdjusterGui: Fetches portion‑size adjustment guidance from the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useSpeechToText.ts: Provides browser speech‑to‑text handling with transcript tracking, errors, and control methods.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom CSS variables for light and dark themes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider setup.
frontend/src/pages/AddEntryPage.tsx: UI form for creating a food entry, including nutrient inputs, portion adjustment, and submission handling.
frontend/src/pages/CameraCapturePage.tsx: Handles camera activation, photo capture, preview, and routing to an estimation confirmation step.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays daily and weekly nutrition data, charts, goals, and food entries with date-range selection.
frontend/src/pages/HealthRecordsPage.tsx: Manages viewing and adding health metric records with validation and metric-specific input handling.
frontend/src/pages/HelperChatPage.tsx: Implements a nutrition Q&A chat interface with message history, suggested prompts, and knowledge‑base lookup.
frontend/src/pages/InstallAppPage.tsx: Checks APK availability and provides download and installation guidance for the Android app.
frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx: Shows branded login screen using Internet Identity with navigation to app installation.
frontend/src/utils/localFoodDataset.ts: Defines the FoodNutrition interface and a large local food database with per‑100g nutrition data and keywords.
frontend/src/utils/localNutritionEstimat: Provides simple keyword‑based food search, random image‑estimation fallback, and nutrition scaling by weight.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, supporting hash‑based routing.
frontend/src/utils/weeklyFeedback.ts: Computes weekly calorie/macro totals, averages, scoring, and text feedback based on logged food entries and goals.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS config defining theme extensions, color tokens, typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Metadata describing the app’s features, architecture, goals, and current known issues for build planning.
